designConclusion.statement: A future diagnostic is not evidentially valid if it only proves that its own named policies exist. It must freeze the complete realtime.messages policy catalog before the case, after policy installation immediately before Realtime client creation/subscription, and after cleanup.
designConclusion.whyItMatters: The three-phase catalog makes concurrent policy pollution, mutation of a pre-existing policy, unexpected policy deltas, and incomplete cleanup observable instead of silently folding those conditions into a Realtime join result.

rules: preserve complete catalog in all three phases
after-install delta must contain exactly the generated SELECT and INSERT policies
pre-existing policies must be byte-equivalent after normalization
generated policies must preserve permissive, roles, cmd, qual and with_check
expected SELECT predicate and stored SELECT qual must both be preserved
cleanup catalog must equal the before-case baseline
any unexpected policy delta invalidates the case evidence
text equality or normalized text equality alone cannot prove SQL predicate semantics
Realtime join outcome alone cannot promote a root-cause conclusion

nextBoundary: R3E is certified repository-only. A later separately certified boundary may prepare a remote diagnostic implementation that consumes this snapshot contract, but staging authority remains false until a fresh explicit authorization is received.
